RepoGroupsInRail.note: Two expanded groups with their workspace rows, a Show more toggle between them, and a collapsed group — the real Repositories tree.

EnvironmentGlyphs.note: The environment axis: FolderClosedFilled/FolderFilled for local (collapsed vs expanded) against FolderRemote for Cloud-capable repos, plus a long label truncating.

HeaderActionsRevealed.note: The hover-revealed trailing actions (new workspace, repository options) shown via focus-on-mount. LIMITATION: the `hoverIcon` folder->chevron swap is keyed on pointer :hover only and cannot be photographed; the folder glyph is what the sheet shows.
